leads.title: Caribbean Territories (Criminal Law) Order, 2000 (United Kingdom)
leads.documents: Express decriminalisation of same-sex sexual acts in Turks and Caicos Islands, effective 1 January 2001; basis for legality of same-sex sexual activity status
leads.detail: Mentioned in 'Legality of same-sex sexual activity' section. No URL or footnote citation detail visible in provided text; References section empty.

leads.title: Constitution of the Turks and Caicos Islands - Article 10 and Article 16
leads.documents: Article 10 limits constitutional right to marry to 'unmarried man and woman' marrying 'a person of the opposite sex' (no same-sex marriage/civil union); Article 16 bans discrimination including on ground of 'sexual orientation' with quoted definition of 'discriminatory'
leads.detail: Direct quotes of Article 10 and Article 16 provided in 'Recognition of same-sex relationships' and 'Discrimination protections' sections. No URL or footnote citation detail visible in provided text.

leads.title: Court of Appeal ruling of 27 October 2025 on Immigration Act - spouse interpretation
leads.documents: First court finding of obligation to recognize same-sex partners: government must interpret 'spouse' in the Immigration Act to include same-sex partners legally married in other jurisdictions, cannot discriminate based on sexual orientation
leads.detail: Described in 'Recognition of same-sex relationships' section dated October 27, 2025. No case name, citation number, or URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Turks and Caicos Islands Immigration Act
leads.documents: Statute containing term 'spouse' at issue in 27 October 2025 Court of Appeal ruling on recognition of foreign same-sex marriages for immigration purposes
